change.summary: Render both race preview models through a neutral GUI-owned vanilla player pipeline

modifiers.before: Both detached player models reuse the live player UUID and can be hidden by world render hooks
modifiers.after: Both models use separate display-only UUIDs and read native appearance from the live player

modifiers.before: The capability override dereferences its live-player source while the RemotePlayer superclass is still constructing
modifiers.after: The detached preview never borrows gameplay capabilities and copies only skin, model-part and equipment appearance from the connected player

modifiers.before: The preview uses the world EntityRenderDispatcher, so camera direction, Epic Fight patches and detailed-animation resource hooks can hide, rotate or offset it
modifiers.after: A GUI-owned vanilla PlayerModel renders at a fixed neutral pose with native armor and cape layers, independent of the world camera and Epic Fight combat mode

modifiers.before: The screen and descriptions hard-code V, B and Shift+B even after the player changes those bindings
modifiers.after: Buttons, shortcuts, cooldowns and descriptions use the active localized KeyMapping labels and match those same bindings

rationale.purpose: Keep the player visible in the main race stage and the ability scene across races

introduced.summary: Give both race preview models a display-only identity

history.summary: Give both race preview models a display-only identity

relations: Detached display identity -> neutral GUI PlayerModel -> live skin and equipment appearance
